def encode(
        self,
        text: str,
        *,
        allowed_special: Literal["all"] | AbstractSet[str] = set(),  # noqa: B006
        disallowed_special: Literal["all"] | Collection[str] = "all",
        chunk_size: int | None = None,
        return_repeated_pattern: bool = False,
    ) -> list[int] | list[list[int]] | tuple[list[int], dict[tuple[int, int], int]]:
        """Encodes a string into tokens.

        Args:
            text: The string to encode.
            allowed_special: Special tokens to allow. Defaults to no special tokens.
            disallowed_special: Special tokens to raise an error on. Defaults to "all".
            chunk_size: If set, the input text is split into chunks of at most this many
                characters before tokenization. The return value becomes a list of token
                lists, one per chunk.
            return_repeated_pattern: If True, returns a tuple of the encoded tokens and a
                dictionary of the top 3 most frequent adjacent token pairs with their counts.

        When both `chunk_size` and `return_repeated_pattern` are set, the pattern analysis is
        performed over the concatenated sequence of all chunks and the return value is a tuple of
        a list of token lists and a dictionary of patterns.
